name: Sky Carrier Vista
prompt: A WIDE 16:9 landscape environment backdrop for a 2.5D beat-'em-up level: the open deck of a colossal FLYING AIRCRAFT CARRIER high in a bright daytime sky. Riveted steel flight-deck stretching left-to-right, a towering island superstructure with radar masts and lit bridge windows off to one side, deck-edge safety railings, yellow warning chevrons painted on the plating. Behind and below: layered drifting clouds and a distant hazy horizon that sells the altitude. Gritty indie-arcade / dark-comic HD cel-shaded look, dramatic rim light, painterly but readable. NO characters, NO UI, NO frame — just the environment, full-bleed, as a game background.
cardartAction: a sweeping wide establishing shot of the flight deck receding toward the island tower, clouds streaming past, sun flaring off wet steel

name: Carrier Deck Plating
prompt: A WIDE 16:9 top-slightly-angled texture panel of a flying aircraft-carrier's steel FLIGHT DECK for a belt-scroller floor: riveted metal plating in weathered gunmetal, oil streaks and scorch marks, a painted yellow centreline with warning chevrons, panel seams running into the distance, deck-edge trim. Tileable feel, even lighting, no strong single light source, no horizon. Gritty indie-arcade HD cel-shaded. NO characters, NO frame — a clean floor-texture backdrop.
cardartAction: the deck plating filling the frame at a shallow belt-scroller angle, chevrons leading the eye left-to-right
